title: The Year the Internet Grew Up
narrative: The Ice Bucket Challenge raises $115 million. Facebook pays $19 billion for WhatsApp. Amazon buys Twitch. Heartbleed exposes the internet's fragile security. Net neutrality becomes a political battle. Bitcoin crashes after Mt. Gox. Uber changes transportation forever.
